description: Palettization constraint knowledge seed. Documents hard constraints on weight palettization (LUT compression) for ANE execution.

conv_palette_minimums.notes: Standard conv palettization requires at least 4-bit LUT. Alternate path supports 3-bit minimum. 1-bit and 2-bit palettization are not supported by ANE hardware.

palette_upcast.notes: On A11-A13, 3-bit palettized weights are silently upcast to 4-bit by the ANECompiler, increasing model size. This does not happen on A14+.

blockwise_scale.detail: ConstexprBlockwiseShiftScale cannot execute on the ANE. Models with blockwise scale must fall back to CPU or use affine dequantization instead.

asymmetric_quant.detail: ANECompiler rejects asymmetric quantization (zero_point != 0) for ANE-placed ops. Only symmetric quantization is allowed.

bf16_model_dtype.constraint: bf16 is not a valid CoreML model data type
bf16_model_dtype.detail: Core ML does not support bf16 as a model data type. Attempting to create a bf16 model will fail at conversion time.
